issues.description: Class de.tum.cit.ase.Farm: the field 'animals' is declared with a different collection type in the solution than required by the problem statement. The problem statement (problem_statement.md lines 108-111) explicitly requires the Farm aggregation to use a List implemented with an ArrayList and to initialize the ArrayList in the no-arg constructor. The solution (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java lines 9-13) declares the field as Queue<Animal> and initializes it with new LinkedList<>(), and its getter/setter use Queue<Animal>. This divergence from the stated List/ArrayList requirement can confuse students following the instructions and may cause tests or expectations that rely on List/ArrayList (or APIs specific to List) to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the problem statement: change the Farm field and its accessor signatures to use List<Animal> (import java.util.List), and initialize it in the no-arg constructor with new ArrayList<>() (import java.util.ArrayList). Update getAnimals()/setAnimals() to return/accept List<Animal>. If Queue semantics were intentionally desired, instead update the problem statement and tests to accept Queue<Animal> and document the reason for using a Queue.
